screenshotMethod: Main game camera, URP SingleCameraRequest, HDR 1920x1080

checks.name: Runtime scene components
checks.detail: FlightInput, FireflyPilot, FireflyGlow and MeadowCamera must exist.

checks.name: Soundscape clips initialized
checks.detail: Initialized 3 clips: Wing flutter, Procedural meadow evening, Soft answer.

checks.name: Ambient fireflies have real lights
checks.detail: Nearby insect billboards must be backed by several enabled Unity point lights.

checks.name: Gamepad deadzone
checks.detail: A small physical stick offset must neither produce movement input nor drift.

checks.name: Analog movement
checks.detail: Half stick must produce analog gamepad movement.

checks.name: Forward flight
checks.detail: Up on the stick must fly forward relative to the camera.

checks.name: Diagonal speed limit
checks.detail: Full diagonal speed 2.291 versus cardinal 2.292.

checks.name: RT ascends
checks.detail: Right trigger alone must fly upward without horizontal drift.

checks.name: LT descends
checks.detail: Left trigger alone must fly downward.

checks.name: Opposite triggers cancel
checks.detail: Simultaneous fully held triggers must produce zero vertical intent.

checks.name: Keyboard vertical fallback
checks.detail: Synthetic Keyboard Space and Left Ctrl must raise and lower the same flight controller.

checks.name: Three dimensional speed limit
checks.detail: Combined horizontal diagonal and ascent speed 2.291 versus cardinal 2.292; the full xyz vector must be normalized.

checks.name: Altitude boundaries
checks.detail: Sustained vertical input must respect altitude bounds (0.50, 9.00).

checks.name: Upward surface collision
checks.detail: Ascending must stop below a ceiling, including the player's sphere radius.

checks.name: Downward surface collision
checks.detail: Descending must stop above a floor; upward normals cannot be ignored in three dimensional flight.

checks.name: Four flight directions
checks.detail: Right, left and backward stick input must move on the camera's ground plane.

checks.name: Camera follows player
checks.detail: The camera must follow horizontal movement while preserving its view offset.

checks.name: Camera obstruction
checks.detail: A temporary obstacle between the target and camera must shorten the view distance.

checks.name: Right stick camera orbit
checks.detail: Right stick must change camera yaw and pitch while an idle player remains still.

checks.name: Flight follows orbit orientation
checks.detail: Forward flight must follow the camera's new horizontal heading after orbiting.

checks.name: Distant camera and tiny player
checks.detail: Player body projected height is 1.89% of the viewport; unobstructed camera distance is 18.00.

checks.name: A press toggles once
checks.detail: Holding South/A must emit one glow press and keep the new light state.

checks.name: A release and second press
checks.detail: A fresh press after release must toggle the glow again.

checks.name: Player glow is a small local light
checks.detail: Player-only point intensity 0.300 lit, 0.000 dark; range 1.65. Other insects' independently flashing lights are excluded from this check.

checks.name: Start pauses flight
checks.detail: Start must freeze three dimensional flight and camera orbit despite held stick/trigger input.

checks.name: Start resumes flight
checks.detail: A second Start press must restore time and movement.

checks.name: RB gentle boost
checks.detail: Right shoulder with stick input must increase flight speed.

checks.name: Gamepad disconnection
checks.detail: Removing the active gamepad must clear horizontal/vertical/orbit/boost input and stop flight.

checks.name: Meadow flight boundaries
checks.detail: Continued outward flight must remain within x [-17, 17] and z [-12, 15].

checks.name: Focus loss pauses safely
checks.detail: A simulated application focus loss must pause and clear flight input.

checks.name: Dark clearing baseline
checks.detail: The comparison frame must precede the first collective response, with the player glow switched off.

checks.name: Clearing answers the player
checks.detail: Lighting the abdomen at the first clearing must trigger one new discovered group and its response event.

checks.name: Collective response lights the environment
checks.detail: Responding real point lights 13, response intensity sum 22.360, ambient intensity sum 0.619. The group must provide actual Unity lighting beyond billboard emission.

checks.name: Light reaches visible brightness
checks.detail: The smooth glow transition must settle into its visible state.

checks.name: Collective frame brightens the meadow
checks.detail: Same camera framing: dark PNG mean luminance 0.00006, collective response 0.00134.
